fields.summary_ko.0: Micron Technology (NASDAQ:MU) rose 6.3% to trade at $508.58, continuing recovery of chip stocks following mid-week selloff last week.
fields.summary_ko.1: Q3 revenue of $54.2 billion increased 379% YoY, but stock volatility persists due to data center regulation concerns from Democratic midterm election victory, with 40 out of 41 voted data center-related bills being negative for the industry.
